description: GEO Jainism frontend -> Cloudinary migration manifest. Masters only; -sm.webp variants, unused assets, backend-uploaded media and local icons are excluded (see README.md).
sourceRoot: geo-jainism-fe (localPath values are relative to this directory)

uploadDefaults.notes: Always pass publicId (full path) as public_id. Dynamic-folder accounts: also pass folder as asset_folder. Fixed-folder accounts: public_id alone defines the folder. Never also pass `folder` with a full-path public_id (it would be prefixed twice). Confirm the folder mode in the dashboard first. Do NOT apply incoming transformations - store pristine masters; optimise at delivery.

hero-lcp-alpha.note: Transparent PNG master; f_auto serves AVIF/WebP with alpha.

decorative-alpha.note: Decorative transparency; eco quality is acceptable.

css-background.note: Set via inline style / CSS custom property (image-set() or media queries) since static CSS cannot read env vars.

carousel-fullbleed.note: Caps the 5088-8192 px sources; this is the largest decode-memory win.

webgl-texture.note: Single fixed size for three.js TextureLoader; requires CORS. If f_auto causes issues in the WebGL path, pin f_webp.

video-background-and-player.fullFilm: f_auto:video,q_auto (optionally sp_auto adaptive streaming for the modal)
video-background-and-player.note: Use preload="metadata" for the background; keep crossOrigin="anonymous" for the WebGL texture.
